verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships and documents a public 'test_keys' repo specifically for trying the scanner on known dummy secrets instead of production data, and this was independently verified by a local probe run producing verified findings against that safe test repo. However, there's no dedicated 'sandbox mode', staging environment, or agent-oriented safe-testing feature beyond this example repo. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging deployment mode, documentation framing this as a safe-testing workflow for AI agents, and independent corroboration beyond the single test repo example.
